AZURE_BLOB.label: Auth Mode
AZURE_BLOB.name: config.auth_mode
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_en: Choose the authentication method. Account Key and Connection String require container_name; SAS Token requires container_url + sas_token.
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_zh: 选择认证方式。账户密钥和连接字符串需填写容器名称；SAS 令牌方式需填写容器 URL 和 SAS 令牌。

AZURE_BLOB.label: Account Key
AZURE_BLOB.name: config.credentials.account_key
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_en: Storage account access key (Base64-encoded). Required for account-key auth.
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_zh: 存储账户访问密钥（Base64 编码），账户密钥认证时必填。

AZURE_BLOB.label: Connection String
AZURE_BLOB.name: config.credentials.connection_string
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_en: Full Azure Storage connection string (DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=...;...). Required for connection-string auth.
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_zh: 完整的 Azure 存储连接字符串（DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=...;...），连接字符串认证时必填。

AZURE_BLOB.label: Container URL
AZURE_BLOB.name: config.credentials.container_url
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_en: Full HTTPS URL of the container (e.g. https://account.blob.core.windows.net/container). Required for SAS-token auth.
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_zh: 容器的完整 HTTPS 地址（例如 https://account.blob.core.windows.net/container），SAS 令牌认证时必填。

AZURE_BLOB.label: SAS Token
AZURE_BLOB.name: config.credentials.sas_token
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_en: SAS query string (without the leading "?"). Required for SAS-token auth.
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_zh: SAS 查询字符串（不含开头的"?"），SAS 令牌认证时必填。

AZURE_BLOB.label: Container Name
AZURE_BLOB.name: config.credentials.container_name
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_en: Name of the container to index. Required for account-key and connection-string auth.
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_zh: 要索引的容器名称，账户密钥和连接字符串认证时必填。

AZURE_BLOB.label: Prefix (optional)
AZURE_BLOB.name: config.prefix
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_en: Optional blob name prefix to limit indexing to a virtual folder (e.g. documents/reports/). Leave blank to index the entire container.
AZURE_BLOB.tooltip_zh: 可选的 Blob 名称前缀，用于限定索引范围（例如 documents/reports/）。留空则索引整个容器。

BIGQUERY.label: Project ID
BIGQUERY.name: config.project_id
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: GCP project that owns the query jobs (e.g. my-gcp-project).

BIGQUERY.label: Location
BIGQUERY.name: config.location
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Default location for the client and query jobs, such as US or EU. Leave empty to let BigQuery infer it.

BIGQUERY.label: Service Account JSON
BIGQUERY.name: config.credentials.service_account_json
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Service account key JSON with BigQuery access. Paste the full key file contents.

BIGQUERY.label: Dataset ID
BIGQUERY.name: config.dataset_id
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Dataset id for table mode. Required together with Table ID when no SQL query is provided.

BIGQUERY.label: Table ID
BIGQUERY.name: config.table_id
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Table id for table mode. Required together with Dataset ID when no SQL query is provided.

BIGQUERY.label: SQL Query
BIGQUERY.name: config.query
BIGQUERY.placeholder: Leave empty to use Dataset ID + Table ID
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Custom GoogleSQL query. Takes precedence over Dataset ID and Table ID. Standard SQL only.

BIGQUERY.label: Content Columns
BIGQUERY.name: config.content_columns
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Comma-separated column names whose values will be combined as document content for vectorization.

BIGQUERY.label: Metadata Columns
BIGQUERY.name: config.metadata_columns
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Comma-separated column names to store as document metadata (not vectorized, but searchable).

BIGQUERY.label: ID Column
BIGQUERY.name: config.id_column
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Column to use as unique document ID. If not specified, a hash of the content will be used.

BIGQUERY.label: Timestamp Column
BIGQUERY.name: config.timestamp_column
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Timestamp, datetime, date, or numeric column for incremental sync. Only rows newer than the last sync will be fetched.

BIGQUERY.label: Max Bytes Billed
BIGQUERY.name: config.maximum_bytes_billed
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Hard cost guard applied to every query job, in bytes. Defaults to 1 GiB.

BIGQUERY.label: Job Timeout (ms)
BIGQUERY.name: config.job_timeout_ms
BIGQUERY.tooltip_en: Optional per-query job timeout in milliseconds.

BITBUCKET.label: Bitbucket Account Email
BITBUCKET.name: config.credentials.bitbucket_account_email
BITBUCKET.tooltip_en: The Bitbucket workspace to index (e.g., "atlassian" from https://bitbucket.org/atlassian/workspace ).
BITBUCKET.tooltip_zh: 要索引的 Bitbucket 工作区（例如：https://bitbucket.org/atlassian/workspace 中的 "atlassian"）

BITBUCKET.label: Bitbucket API Token
BITBUCKET.name: config.credentials.bitbucket_api_token
BITBUCKET.tooltip_en: The Bitbucket workspace to index (e.g., "atlassian" from https://bitbucket.org/atlassian/workspace ).
BITBUCKET.tooltip_zh: 要索引的 Bitbucket 工作区（例如：https://bitbucket.org/atlassian/workspace 中的 "atlassian"）

BITBUCKET.label: Workspace
BITBUCKET.name: config.workspace
BITBUCKET.tooltip_en: The Bitbucket workspace to index (e.g., "atlassian" from https://bitbucket.org/atlassian/workspace ).
BITBUCKET.tooltip_zh: 要索引的 Bitbucket 工作区（例如：https://bitbucket.org/atlassian/workspace 中的 "atlassian"）

CONFLUENCE.label: Confluence Username
CONFLUENCE.name: config.credentials.confluence_username
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_en: The base URL of your Confluence instance (e.g., https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki)
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_zh: Confluence Wiki 的基础 URL（例如 https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki）

CONFLUENCE.label: Confluence Access Token
CONFLUENCE.name: config.credentials.confluence_access_token
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_en: The base URL of your Confluence instance (e.g., https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki)
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_zh: Confluence Wiki 的基础 URL（例如 https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki）

CONFLUENCE.label: Wiki Base URL
CONFLUENCE.name: config.wiki_base
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_en: The base URL of your Confluence instance (e.g., https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki)
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_zh: Confluence Wiki 的基础 URL（例如 https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki）

CONFLUENCE.label: Is Cloud
CONFLUENCE.name: config.is_cloud
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_en: Check if this is a Confluence Cloud instance, uncheck for Confluence Server/Data Center
CONFLUENCE.tooltip_zh: 检查这是否是 Confluence Cloud 实例，如果是 Confluence 服务/数据中心，则取消选中。

DROPBOX.label: Access Token
DROPBOX.name: config.credentials.dropbox_access_token
DROPBOX.tooltip_en: Generate a long-lived access token in the Dropbox App Console with files.metadata.read, files.content.read, and sharing.read scopes.
DROPBOX.tooltip_zh: 请在 Dropbox App Console 生成 Access Token，并勾选 files.metadata.read、files.content.read、sharing.read 等必要权限。

GMAIL.label: Primary Admin Email
GMAIL.name: config.credentials.google_primary_admin
GMAIL.tooltip_en: Primary admin email with Gmail / Workspace access, used to enumerate domain users and as the default sync account.
GMAIL.tooltip_zh: 拥有 Gmail / Workspace 访问权限的主要管理员邮箱，用于列出域内用户并作为默认同步账号。

GMAIL.label: OAuth Token JSON
GMAIL.name: config.credentials.google_tokens
GMAIL.tooltip_en: Upload the OAuth JSON generated from Google Console. If it only contains client credentials, run the browser-based verification once to mint long-lived refresh tokens.
GMAIL.tooltip_zh: 请上传由 Google Console 生成的 OAuth JSON。如果仅包含 client credentials，请通过浏览器授权一次以获取长期有效的刷新 Token。

GOOGLE_DRIVE.label: Primary Admin Email
GOOGLE_DRIVE.name: config.credentials.google_primary_admin
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_en: Email address that has access to the Drive content being synced
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_zh: 拥有相应 Drive 访问权限的管理员邮箱。

GOOGLE_DRIVE.label: OAuth Token JSON
GOOGLE_DRIVE.name: config.credentials.google_tokens
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_en: Upload the OAuth token JSON generated from the OAuth helper or Google Cloud Console. You may also upload a client_secret JSON from an "installed" or "web" application. If this is your first sync, a browser window will open to complete the OAuth consent. If the JSON already contains a refresh token, it will be reused automatically.
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_zh: 请上传由 OAuth helper 或 Google Cloud Console 导出的 OAuth token JSON。也支持上传 “installed” 或 “web” 类型的 client_secret JSON。若为首次同步，将自动弹出浏览器完成 OAuth 授权流程；如果该 JSON 已包含 refresh token，将会被自动复用。

GOOGLE_DRIVE.label: My Drive Emails
GOOGLE_DRIVE.name: config.my_drive_emails
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_en: Comma-separated emails whose "My Drive" contents should be indexed (include the primary admin).
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_zh: 需要索引其 “我的云端硬盘” 的邮箱，多个邮箱用逗号分隔（建议包含管理员）。

GOOGLE_DRIVE.label: Shared Folder URLs
GOOGLE_DRIVE.name: config.shared_folder_urls
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_en: Comma-separated Google Drive folder links to crawl.
GOOGLE_DRIVE.tooltip_zh: 需要同步的 Google Drive 文件夹链接，多个链接用逗号分隔。

JIRA.label: Jira User Email
JIRA.name: config.credentials.jira_user_email
JIRA.tooltip_en: Email associated with the Jira account/API token.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 与 API Token 对应的 Jira 账户邮箱。

JIRA.label: Jira Username
JIRA.name: config.credentials.jira_username
JIRA.tooltip_en: Email associated with the Jira account/API token.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 与 API Token 对应的 Jira 账户邮箱。

JIRA.label: Jira Base URL
JIRA.name: config.base_url
JIRA.tooltip_en: Base URL of your Jira site (e.g., https://your-domain.atlassian.net).

JIRA.label: Project Key
JIRA.name: config.project_key
JIRA.tooltip_en: Optional: limit syncing to a single project key (e.g., ENG).
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 可选：仅同步指定的项目（如 RAG）。

JIRA.label: Custom JQL
JIRA.name: config.jql_query
JIRA.tooltip_en: Optional JQL filter. Leave blank to rely on project/time filters.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 可选：自定义 JQL 过滤条件，留空则使用项目 / 时间范围。

JIRA.label: Batch Size
JIRA.name: config.batch_size
JIRA.tooltip_en: Maximum number of issues requested from Jira per batch.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 每次向 Jira 请求的 Issue 数量上限。

JIRA.label: Attachment Size Limit (bytes)
JIRA.name: config.attachment_size_limit
JIRA.tooltip_en: Attachments larger than this number of bytes will be skipped.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 超过该字节阈值的附件会被跳过。

JIRA.label: Labels to Skip
JIRA.name: config.labels_to_skip
JIRA.tooltip_en: Labels that should be skipped while indexing (comma separated).
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 需要跳过的标签（逗号分隔）。

JIRA.label: Comment Email Blacklist
JIRA.name: config.comment_email_blacklist
JIRA.tooltip_en: Comments whose author email matches these entries will be ignored.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 这些邮箱作者的评论会被忽略。

JIRA.label: Include Comments
JIRA.name: config.include_comments
JIRA.tooltip_en: Include Jira comments in the generated markdown document.

JIRA.label: Include Attachments
JIRA.name: config.include_attachments
JIRA.tooltip_en: Download attachments as separate documents during sync.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 开启后会将附件下载为独立文档。

JIRA.label: Mode
JIRA.name: config.is_cloud
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 在 https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens 生成的 API Token。 (Clould only)

JIRA.label: Jira Password
JIRA.name: config.credentials.jira_password
JIRA.tooltip_en: Optional password for Jira Server/Data Center environments.
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 可选：仅 Jira Server/Data Center 环境需要的密码字段。

JIRA.label: Use Scoped Token
JIRA.name: config.scoped_token
JIRA.tooltip_en: Enable this when using scoped Atlassian tokens (api.atlassian.com).
JIRA.tooltip_zh: 仅当凭证为 Atlassian scoped token（api.atlassian.com）时生效。

MYSQL.label: SQL Query
MYSQL.name: config.query
MYSQL.placeholder: Leave empty to load all tables
MYSQL.tooltip_en: SQL query to extract data from your database (e.g., SELECT * FROM products WHERE status = "active").

MYSQL.label: Content Columns
MYSQL.name: config.content_columns
MYSQL.tooltip_en: Comma-separated column names whose values will be combined as document content for vectorization.

MYSQL.label: Metadata Columns
MYSQL.name: config.metadata_columns
MYSQL.tooltip_en: Comma-separated column names to store as document metadata (not vectorized, but searchable).

MYSQL.label: ID Column
MYSQL.name: config.id_column
MYSQL.tooltip_en: Column to use as unique document ID. If not specified, a hash of the content will be used.

MYSQL.label: Timestamp Column
MYSQL.name: config.timestamp_column
MYSQL.tooltip_en: Datetime/timestamp column for incremental sync. Only rows modified after the last sync will be fetched.

ONEDRIVE.label: Tenant ID
ONEDRIVE.name: config.credentials.tenant_id
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_en: Azure Active Directory tenant ID (Directory ID) of the Microsoft 365 organisation.
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_zh: Microsoft 365 组织的 Azure Active Directory 租户 ID（目录 ID）。

ONEDRIVE.label: Client ID
ONEDRIVE.name: config.credentials.client_id
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_en: Application (client) ID of the Azure AD app registration with Files.Read.All permission.
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_zh: 拥有 Files.Read.All 权限的 Azure AD 应用注册的应用程序（客户端）ID。

ONEDRIVE.label: Client Secret
ONEDRIVE.name: config.credentials.client_secret
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_en: Client secret value generated in the Azure AD app registration.
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_zh: 在 Azure AD 应用注册中生成的客户端密钥值。

ONEDRIVE.label: Folder Path (optional)
ONEDRIVE.name: config.folder_path
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_en: Optional sub-folder path to limit indexing (e.g. /Documents/Reports). Leave blank to index the entire drive.
ONEDRIVE.tooltip_zh: 可选的子文件夹路径，用于限制索引范围（例如 /Documents/Reports）。留空则索引整个云盘。

OUTLOOK.label: Tenant ID
OUTLOOK.name: config.credentials.tenant_id
OUTLOOK.tooltip_en: Azure Active Directory tenant ID (Directory ID) of the Microsoft 365 organisation.
OUTLOOK.tooltip_zh: Microsoft 365 组织的 Azure Active Directory 租户 ID（目录 ID）。

OUTLOOK.label: Client ID
OUTLOOK.name: config.credentials.client_id
OUTLOOK.tooltip_en: Application (client) ID of the Azure AD app registration with Mail.Read permission.
OUTLOOK.tooltip_zh: 拥有 Mail.Read 权限的 Azure AD 应用注册的应用程序（客户端）ID。

OUTLOOK.label: Client Secret
OUTLOOK.name: config.credentials.client_secret
OUTLOOK.tooltip_en: Client secret value generated in the Azure AD app registration.
OUTLOOK.tooltip_zh: 在 Azure AD 应用注册中生成的客户端密钥值。

OUTLOOK.label: Mail Folder
OUTLOOK.name: config.folder
OUTLOOK.tooltip_en: Mail folder to sync (e.g. inbox, sentitems, archive). Defaults to inbox.
OUTLOOK.tooltip_zh: 要同步的邮件文件夹（例如 inbox、sentitems、archive），默认为 inbox。

OUTLOOK.label: Mailbox User IDs (optional)
OUTLOOK.name: config.user_ids
OUTLOOK.tooltip_en: Comma-separated UPNs or object IDs of mailboxes to sync. Leave blank to sync every mailbox in the tenant (requires User.Read.All).
OUTLOOK.tooltip_zh: 要同步的邮箱 UPN 或对象 ID 列表（逗号分隔）。留空则同步租户内的所有邮箱（需要 User.Read.All 权限）。

POSTGRESQL.label: SQL Query
POSTGRESQL.name: config.query
POSTGRESQL.placeholder: Leave empty to load all tables

POSTGRESQL.label: Content Columns
POSTGRESQL.name: config.content_columns
POSTGRESQL.tooltip_en: Comma-separated column names whose values will be combined as document content for vectorization.

POSTGRESQL.label: Metadata Columns
POSTGRESQL.name: config.metadata_columns
POSTGRESQL.tooltip_en: Comma-separated column names to store as document metadata (not vectorized, but searchable).

POSTGRESQL.label: ID Column
POSTGRESQL.name: config.id_column
POSTGRESQL.tooltip_en: Column to use as unique document ID. If not specified, a hash of the content will be used.

POSTGRESQL.label: Timestamp Column
POSTGRESQL.name: config.timestamp_column
POSTGRESQL.tooltip_en: Datetime/timestamp column for incremental sync. Only rows modified after the last sync will be fetched.

REST_API.label: Items Path
REST_API.name: config.items_path
REST_API.tooltip_en: Field name or JSONPath to the array of items in the response. Leave empty to auto-detect (tries "items", "results", "data", etc.).

REST_API.label: ID Field
REST_API.name: config.id_field
REST_API.tooltip_en: Field path within each item used to build a stable document ID. Leave empty to auto-generate from content hash.

REST_API.label: Content Fields
REST_API.name: config.content_fields
REST_API.tooltip_en: Comma-separated list of item fields to concatenate into the document content.

REST_API.label: Metadata Fields
REST_API.name: config.metadata_fields
REST_API.tooltip_en: Comma-separated list of item fields to store as metadata.

REST_API.label: Next Cursor JSONPath
REST_API.name: config.pagination_config.next_cursor_path
REST_API.tooltip_en: JSONPath expression that resolves to the next-page cursor in the API response.

REST_API.label: Custom Headers (JSON)
REST_API.name: config.headers
REST_API.tooltip_en: Optional JSON object of additional HTTP headers to send with every request.

REST_API.label: Limit Param
REST_API.name: config.pagination_config.limit_param
REST_API.placeholder: limit (leave empty if already in Query Parameters)

REST_API.label: Request Delay (seconds)
REST_API.name: config.request_delay
REST_API.tooltip_en: Delay in seconds between consecutive page requests. Helps avoid rate limiting from the API. Set to 0 to disable.

REST_API.label: Poll Timestamp Field
REST_API.name: config.poll_timestamp_field
REST_API.tooltip_en: Field path in each item that represents the last updated time, used for incremental sync.

REST_API.label: Request Body (POST) JSON
REST_API.name: config.request_body
REST_API.tooltip_en: Optional JSON body to send for POST requests. Used together with query params and pagination.

SALESFORCE.label: Instance URL
SALESFORCE.name: config.credentials.instance_url
SALESFORCE.tooltip_en: Salesforce org URL, e.g. https://your-domain.my.salesforce.com (no trailing slash).
SALESFORCE.tooltip_zh: Salesforce 组织地址，例如 https://your-domain.my.salesforce.com（不要包含末尾斜杠）。

SALESFORCE.label: Client ID
SALESFORCE.name: config.credentials.client_id
SALESFORCE.tooltip_en: Consumer Key of a Connected App with Client Credentials Flow enabled and the api scope.
SALESFORCE.tooltip_zh: 已启用 Client Credentials Flow 且包含 api 权限的 Connected App 的 Consumer Key。

SALESFORCE.label: Client Secret
SALESFORCE.name: config.credentials.client_secret
SALESFORCE.tooltip_en: Consumer Secret of the Connected App used for client-credentials authentication.
SALESFORCE.tooltip_zh: 用于客户端凭证身份验证的 Connected App 的 Consumer Secret。

SALESFORCE.label: Objects
SALESFORCE.name: config.objects
SALESFORCE.tooltip_en: Comma-separated SObject API names to index. Defaults to Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Knowledge__kav.
SALESFORCE.tooltip_zh: 要索引的 SObject API 名称列表（逗号分隔）。默认值：Account, Contact, Opportunity, Case, Knowledge__kav。

SALESFORCE.label: API Version
SALESFORCE.name: config.api_version
SALESFORCE.tooltip_en: Salesforce REST API version (e.g. v59.0). Use the version your org supports.
SALESFORCE.tooltip_zh: Salesforce REST API 版本（例如 v59.0），请使用您组织所支持的版本。

SEAFILE.label: SeaFile Server URL
SEAFILE.name: config.seafile_url
SEAFILE.tooltip_en: The full URL of your SeaFile server including the protocol. Example: https://seafile.example.com - Do not include a trailing slash or any path after the domain.

SEAFILE.label: Batch Size
SEAFILE.name: config.batch_size
SEAFILE.tooltip_en: The number of documents processed and returned per batch during synchronisation.

SHAREPOINT.label: Site URL
SHAREPOINT.name: config.credentials.site_url
SHAREPOINT.tooltip_en: Full URL of the SharePoint site to index, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/MySite. Requires an Azure AD app with Sites.Read.All and Files.Read.All application permissions (admin consent).
SHAREPOINT.tooltip_zh: 要索引的 SharePoint 站点完整 URL，例如 https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/MySite。需要具备 Sites.Read.All 与 Files.Read.All 应用权限（管理员同意）的 Azure AD 应用。

SLACK.label: Slack Bot Token
SLACK.name: config.credentials.slack_bot_token
SLACK.tooltip_en: Slack bot user OAuth token (starts with xoxb-). The app needs the channels:read, channels:history, and users:read scopes.
SLACK.tooltip_zh: Slack 机器人用户 OAuth Token（以 xoxb- 开头）。应用需具备 channels:read、channels:history 和 users:read 权限。

TEAMS.label: Tenant ID
TEAMS.name: config.credentials.tenant_id
TEAMS.tooltip_en: Azure AD tenant ID. Requires an app with Team.ReadBasic.All and ChannelMessage.Read.All application permissions (admin consent).
TEAMS.tooltip_zh: Azure AD 租户 ID。需要具备 Team.ReadBasic.All 与 ChannelMessage.Read.All 应用权限（管理员同意）的应用。

WEBDAV.label: Remote Path
WEBDAV.name: config.remote_path
WEBDAV.tooltip_en: Optional: Specify a folder path on the WebDAV server (e.g., /Documents). Leave empty to sync from root.
